Image 3 is existing CHEZ TONTON mascot logo; use faithful brand identity, burgundy banner and yellow letters, friendly orange bearded man with round glasses and burgundy cap. Images 4 and 5 are actual bar/cave: use these real photographs as small interior panels, preserve modest industrial wood barrel environment, not fantasy brewery. Layout: tiny logo on top left, clean navigation 'Le bar' 'La cave' 'Les rendez-vous' 'Nous trouver'. Hero on textured warm cream #F2EBDC, gigantic condensed headline 'LE GOÛT DES BONS MOMENTS.' wrapping three lines, black and muted ochre, left two thirds; right third amber unbranded beer bottle and photorealistic golden beer glass with creamy foam and cinematic amber splash curling in an elegant arc. Heading integrates foreground and background layers, grounded shadows, handcrafted premium graphic design, no fake own beer label. Small 'BAR · CAVE · PONTCHÂTEAU', buttons 'Découvrir le lieu' and 'Nous trouver'. Next asymmetrical split with title 'DU COMPTOIR À LA CAVE.' and actual bar and cave photos. Next full-bleed convivial adults around camera photograph, title 'LES BONS MOMENTS SE PARTAGENT.' Next cream editorial section 3 large categories 'Bières' 'Vins' 'Spiritueux', tasteful unbranded bottle still-lifes. Exceptional typography alignment and whitespace; natural material texture, sophisticated lively personality. No ecommerce cart, no invented prices, reviews, awards or reservation engine. Text accurately French, full design readable. Concept images not claimed actual customers.

Warm ivory #F2EBDC, very subtle fine natural fibers and tiny irregular grain, evenly lit, no strong vignettes, no corners or fold creases, no stains, no lettering or illustrations, no watermark. Clean understated printed poster tactile surface suited behind bold charcoal typography. It is a background asset, not a poster. No symbols or text.

A single ordinary elegant 330ml brown amber glass beer bottle with gold crown cap, realistic condensation, absolutely NO label, text, emblem or branding. Side studio daylight on warm amber glass, tiny realistic droplets, premium macro product photo, true proportions and physically plausible glass. Isolate bottle with actual transparent background, no floor, no baked rectangular shadow, no opaque backdrop, no other objects. This is generic illustrative imagery, not a beer brewed by Chez TonTon.

Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape transparent PNG production asset for a premium cinematic beer website. A single visually elegant suspended ribbon of golden amber beer liquid forming a large diagonal open S curve from top left to bottom right. Thin translucent liquid with believable surface tension, restrained small droplets, a few foam bubbles at one tip, high-speed beverage photography realism, warm malty light, detailed caustics. Whole arc contained in frame with ample margin. No glass, no bottles, no hops, no words. Actual transparent background with clean alpha including translucent liquid, no black background or opaque color panel, no rectangle. Luxury craft liquid movement asset, avoid chaos and endless particles.

No splash, no hands, no extra objects, no opaque floor or backdrop; actual transparency suitable on ivory website. Generic conceptual glass not an actual photographed product from a brewery.

Accurate hand anatomy, physically plausible tap spout pouring into glass rim, golden amber stream, textured natural foam, dark charcoal bar shadows and warm cinematic light. Looking between brown and green unbranded beer bottles, realistic cold condensation and cold muted blue light inside fridge, an adult hand reaches toward center bottle from doorway; softly blurred adult aged 35 behind doorway with warm amber bar light beyond. Premium commercial beverage photography, shallow depth, photorealistic glass and anatomy, readable depth from cold foreground to warm world behind. Center bottle only partially lifted, no brand labels or text anywhere. No minors, no unrealistic fingers. Concept campaign image, not actual Chez TonTon customers or equipment.

Four clearly adult friends aged 30–45 of varied appearances, laughing naturally, leaning in and raising beer glasses gently around the lens; realistic authentic warmth, candid expressions not staged stock smiles. Wooden ceiling softly blurred, warm light, one person with glasses, casual elegant clothes. Hands anatomically accurate, believable glasses with amber beer, no logos or text, no intoxication theatrics. Shot on 24mm photographic lens, natural film texture, amber highlights and deep charcoal. Not depicting actual customers or staff of Chez TonTon; conceptual campaign only. Entire faces within frame, no giant fisheye distortion.
